Author: pyreymo
Name: Event Horizon
Description: Cull distant or irrelevant world objects around your character. Use /eventhorizon or /eh to open settings.
Changelog:
- Added a configurable hold shortcut (Ctrl + Alt by default) to temporarily show all players without changing your culling settings.
- Added scene-rendering controls for background objects, terrain, water, grass, and all 3D rendering.
- Reworked player admission around the game's draw-enabling path to suppress spawn flashes and keep hidden state reliable as player slots change or are reused.
- Improved culling responsiveness and performance with faster topology-aware refreshes, lower selection stickiness, and reliable deferred player reveals.
- Expanded the player preview with clearer paused/empty states and detailed motion-aware selection scores, predicted distances, and score breakdowns.
- Fixed companion, battle-pet, ornament, and Event NPC culling rules; NPCs with nameplate icons are now preserved. Experimental battle-pet and Event NPC hiding are disabled by default for new configurations.
- Refined settings layouts, status text, localization, marker defaults, and targeting-me marker placement.
